other_conditions: Applicant must be a resident of Madhya Pradesh.
Student must be enrolled in a government school and be studying in Class 11 or Class 12.
Student must have passed the preceding examination with first division (Class 10 for Class 11 students, Class 11 for Class 12 students).
benefits_summary: Girl students receive ₹550 per year and boy students receive ₹500 per year, transferred directly to the student’s bank account.
